correctness.rationale: The 12-vertex 24-arc directed graph and unique triple-012 anchor give a bijection with rotation classes. Depth-first search exhausts all Euler tours; independent last-exit enumeration exhausts exactly 2048 complete assignments, proves exactly 384 valid in-arborescences and reconstructs the identical 384 tours. All 24 alphabet permutations with both reversal flags are checked on every tour; exact fixed counts and all 20 class representatives are reproduced, yielding Burnside counts 20 and 11. Finite enumeration is exhaustive for the finite claim, and no infinite extrapolation is made.

value.rationale: The 384 known labeled cycles are not the intended new fact: the natural symbol-independent and mirror-independent isomorphism questions require a nonfree S4 action. The exact 20-class and 11-mirror-class classification, complete stabilizer and fixed-point tables, eight exceptional transposition-symmetric classes and explicit canonical representatives resolve the full smallest interesting shorthand permutation case. The result is a motivated complete structural classification, not an arbitrary subrange of an unrelated dataset; it is limited to this four-letter case.
